fields.description: Playa Del Sol is an Ellington coastal development on Al Marjan Island, offering apartments, three-bedroom duplexes, four-bedroom penthouses and a five-bedroom villa. Its shared spaces combine waterside leisure with fitness, play and social facilities.

overview: A varied coastal home mix is supported by shared leisure, fitness and family spaces.
research.locationNote: Al Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah. Views and nearby resort access are unit- and operator-dependent, not guaranteed by a marketing map.
research.priceNote: Property Finder’s FAQ states AED 3,289,828, rounded to AED 3.3 million. This is a launch reference, not a verified current available unit or selected payment offer.
research.paymentNote: The table follows the original guide. It separately adds AED 3,000 registration and 4% title-registration charges outside the purchase-price percentages; confirm current charges.
research.handoverNote: The brief anticipates Q4 2027, matching the portal’s December 2027 headline. Its separate June 2026 FAQ conflicts; no completed handover is inferred.
